Rashi on Menachot 14b:10:1.english: And if Rabbi holds that an entire permitting factor and half a measure of consumption - [They] combine to render [the offering] piggul.

Rashi on Menachot 14b:10:2.hebrew: ליגזר חצי מתיר וחצי אכילה - דליפסול, אטו כולו מתיר וחצי אכילה, דכרת הוא:
Rashi on Menachot 14b:10:2.english: Let him decree [concerning] half a permitting factor and half [a measure of] consumption - That it should disqualify [the offering], on account of an entire permitting factor and half [a measure of] consumption, which entails karet.

Rashi on Menachot 14b:10:3.hebrew: דהא רבי יוסי גזר - במתני' (לעיל מנחות דף יג.) בהקומץ את המנחה ע"מ להקטיר לבונתה למחר, ואמר פסול, ואע"ג דאין בו פיגול, דגזר ליה אטו פיגול:
Rashi on Menachot 14b:10:3.english: For Rabbi Yosei decreed - In the mishna (above, Menachot 13a), regarding one who removes a handful from the meal offering with the intention to burn its frankincense tomorrow, and [Rabbi Yosei] said it is unfit, even though there is no piggul in it, for he decreed it due to piggul.

Rashi on Menachot 14b:10:4.hebrew: ורבנן - נמי במתניתין, דקתני: פיגל בהקטרת קומץ ע"מ לאכול שיריים למחר, ולא פיגל בהקטרת לבונה:
Rashi on Menachot 14b:10:4.english: And the Rabbis - [State their view] as well in our mishna, which teaches: "[If] one had intent of piggul during the burning of the handful with the intention to eat the remainder tomorrow, and did not have intent of piggul during the burning of the frankincense."

Rashi on Menachot 14b:12:1.hebrew: ר"מ אומר פיגול - הן השיריים, דאית ליה מפגלין בשעת עבודת חצי מתיר:
Rashi on Menachot 14b:12:1.english: Rabbi Meir says: Piggul - [It is] the remainder [that becomes piggul], for he holds that one renders [an offering] piggul during the service of half of a permitting factor.

Rashi on Menachot 14b:12:2.hebrew: וחכ"א אין בו כרת כו' - כרת הוא דליכא, אבל פסול הוא מלאכול, דגזרינן אטו כרת; ורבי אומר לעיל (עמוד א) בהדיא: כשר:
Rashi on Menachot 14b:12:2.english: And the Rabbis say: There is no karet, etc. - It is [only] karet that does not apply, but it is disqualified from being eaten, as we decree [that it is disqualified] due to [the case that incurs] karet; and [yet] Rabbi says above (page 14a) explicitly: "[It is] valid."

Rashi on Menachot 14b:14:1.english: And the Rabbis as well, who decreed - That the meal offering is disqualified when one has [improper] intent regarding the leftover portions at the time of the burning of the handful.

Rashi on Menachot 14b:1:2.hebrew: הכא - פיגל בירך ימין, דחשיב בבשר גופיה:
Rashi on Menachot 14b:1:2.english: Here - [Where] he had intent of piggul with regard to the right thigh, which is considered [part of] the meat itself.

Rashi on Menachot 14b:1:3.english: All the more so - That even the left [thigh] is rendered piggul.

Rashi on Menachot 14b:2:1.hebrew: אלא א"ר יוחנן - ליתא לרב הונא, ואם פיגל בימין פיגל בשמאל, דהא חזינן אפי' לא חישב אלא בדם, נתפגל בשר. וגבי חלות, ה"ט דרבי יוסי, דאמר במתניתין דתרי גופי נינהו, ואם פיגל בזו לא נתפגלה זו, ולעיל קתני בשתיהן בכזית, דמשמע מדמצטרפות דחד גופא נינהו:
Rashi on Menachot 14b:2:1.english: Rather, Rabbi Yoḥanan said - Rav Huna's [statement] is rejected, and [rather] if one had intent of piggul with regard to the right [thigh], the left [thigh] is [also] rendered piggul, for we see that even if he had intent only regarding the blood, the meat is rendered piggul. And regarding the loaves, this is the reasoning of Rabbi Yosei, who said in our mishna that they are two bodies, and [therefore] if he had intent of piggul with regard to this one, that one is not rendered piggul, whereas earlier it is taught [that an intent regarding] both of them [combines] for an olive-bulk, which implies, since they combine, that they are one body.

Rashi on Menachot 14b:2:2.hebrew: הכתוב עשאן גוף אחד והכתוב עשאן ב' גופין - הכתוב עשאן גוף אחד, דמעכבי אהדדי, דאין זו כשרה בלא זו, דכתיב (ויקרא כ״ג:י״ז) שתים שני עשרונים, דמשמע שתים ולא אחת, וכתיב (שם) סלת תהיינה, וכל הוייה עיכובא. ואותו כתוב עצמו עשאן שני גופין, מדכתיב שתים, דמשמע דכל אחת לישתה ועריכתה בפני עצמה. הלכך, ערבינהו – דאמר כזית בין שתיהן – מתערבין ומצטרפין, דהכתוב עשאן גוף אחד:
Rashi on Menachot 14b:2:2.english: The verse renders them one body, and the verse renders them two bodies - The verse renders them one body — for they preclude one another, as this [loaf] is not valid without that [one], as it is written (Leviticus 23:17): "Two [loaves], of two-tenths [of an ephah]," which implies two and not one; and it is written (ibid.): "fine flour they shall be," and every [instance of the term] "shall be" denotes indispensability. And that very same verse renders them two bodies, since it is written: "two," which implies that each one's kneading and shaping [must be done] on its own. Therefore, [if] he combined them — in that he stated [an intention to eat] an olive-bulk between both of them — they combine and join together, as the verse renders them one body.

Rashi on Menachot 14b:3:1.english: [If] he separated them - Where he said [that he slaughters] on condition to eat from the one [loaf], and did not combine its fellow with it.

Rashi on Menachot 14b:3:2.hebrew: מפלגי - ואין חבירתה פיגול, דהרי הכתוב עשאן שני גופים. יש לשונות אחרים בהלכה זו, אבל זו עיקר:
Rashi on Menachot 14b:3:2.english: They are separated - And its fellow [loaf] is not piggul, for the verse rendered them two bodies. There are other versions of this halakha, but this is the primary one.

Rashi on Menachot 14b:4:1.hebrew: פיגל בלחמי תודה - שהן ארבעה מינים, ופיגל באחד מן המינים: מי פליגי רבי יוסי ורבנן בהא, אם נתפגלו האחרים או לא? מי אמרינן: כיון דזבח אחד מתירן כחד דמיין, או דלמא כיון דלאו חד מינא הוא, פליג רבי יוסי:
Rashi on Menachot 14b:4:1.english: If one had intent of piggul with regard to the loaves of a thanks offering - Which are four types, and one had intent of piggul with regard to one of the types: Do Rabbi Yosei and the Rabbis disagree on this, [as to] whether the other [types] are rendered piggul or not? Do we say: Since one sacrifice permits them, they are considered as one; or perhaps, since it is not one type, Rabbi Yosei disagrees?

Rashi on Menachot 14b:4:2.hebrew: במנחת מאפה - שיש בה שני מינין, ה' חלות וה' רקיקין, כדאמר בפרק התודה (לקמן מנחות דף נז), ואליבא דר"ש קנסיב להו. מהו? מי אמר: הואיל וקומץ אחד לשניהם, לא פליג רבי יוסי, ואם פיגל בחלות נתפגלו רקיקין, או דלמא כיון דשני מינין, פליג:
Rashi on Menachot 14b:4:2.english: With regard to a baked meal offering - In which there are two kinds, five loaves and five wafers, as [the Gemara] says in the chapter of Hatodah (below, Menachot 57), and [Rabbi Yoḥanan] poses [the dilemma] according to Rabbi Shimon. What is [the halakha]? Do we say: Since a single handful [is taken] for both of them, Rabbi Yosei does not disagree, and if he had intent of piggul regarding the loaves, the wafers are [also] rendered piggul? Or perhaps, since they are two kinds, he disagrees?

Rashi on Menachot 14b:4:3.english: And likewise you say - That here too, [Rabbi Yosei] disagrees.

Rashi on Menachot 14b:5:1.hebrew: בשעת שחיטה כו' - אסתם זבח קאי. שחיטה וזריקה מתירין נינהו: שחיטה קדשה לדם, כדאמר בשילהי פירקין (דף טז:), ואמר התם: "הבא לקדש כבא להתיר דמי", וזריקה מתרת הבשר:
Rashi on Menachot 14b:5:1.english: At the time of slaughter, etc. - [The baraita] refers to an ordinary animal sacrifice. Slaughter and sprinkling are [its] permitting factors: slaughter sanctifies the blood, as [the Gemara] says at the end of our chapter (page 16b), and it says there: "That which comes to sanctify is considered like that which comes to permit"; and sprinkling permits the meat.

Rashi on Menachot 14b:6:1.hebrew: קבלה והולכה - דלאו מתירין נינהו, לא מצטרפין, דקבלה אינה מתרת, דאינה אלא לצורך זריקה:
Rashi on Menachot 14b:6:1.english: Collection and conveying - As they are not permitting factors, [intentions during them] do not combine, for collection does not permit [the offering], as it is only for the purpose of sprinkling.

Rashi on Menachot 14b:6:2.hebrew: שחיטה וזריקה מרחקי אהדדי ומצטרפין, וכ"ש קבלה והולכה דמקרבן:
Rashi on Menachot 14b:6:2.english: Slaughter and sprinkling are distant from one another and [yet] combine, and all the more so collection and conveying, which are close to one another.

Rashi on Menachot 14b:7:1.hebrew: אין מצטרפין - שתים מהן ביחד, אם חישב בזו על חצי זית ובזו על חצי זית:
Rashi on Menachot 14b:7:1.english: Do not combine - Two of them together, if he had intent during this one regarding half an olive-bulk and during that one regarding half an olive-bulk.

Rashi on Menachot 14b:7:2.hebrew: הא רבי הא רבנן - הא דתני אין מצטרפות, רבי היא:
Rashi on Menachot 14b:7:2.english: This is Rabbi, that is the Rabbis - That which is taught, "They do not combine," is [the opinion of] Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi].

Rashi on Menachot 14b:9:1.hebrew: חצי מתיר וחצי אכילה - כגון כבש הוי חצי מתיר, ולא חישב עליו אלא בחצי אכילה:
Rashi on Menachot 14b:9:1.english: Half a permitting factor and half [a measure of] consumption - For example, a lamb is half a permitting factor, and he had intent regarding it only for half [a measure of] consumption.

Rashi on Menachot 14b:9:2.hebrew: כולו מתיר וחצי אכילה - כגון שחיטה דכולו מתיר בדם, וזריקה דכולו מתיר בבשר:
Rashi on Menachot 14b:9:2.english: An entire permitting factor and half [a measure of] consumption - Such as slaughter, which is an entire permitting factor with respect to the blood, and sprinkling, which is an entire permitting factor with respect to the meat.

Rashi on Menachot 14b:9:3.hebrew: מי שמעת ליה - דאם חישב בזו בחצי זית ובזו בחצי זית, דאין מצטרפין:
Rashi on Menachot 14b:9:3.english: Did you hear him [say] - That if one had intention in this [service] regarding half an olive-bulk and in that [service] regarding half an olive-bulk, that they do not combine?

Tosafot on Menachot 14b:2:1.hebrew: הכתוב עשאן גוף אחד - דכתיב (ויקרא כ״ג:י״ז) תביאו לחם תנופה; והכתוב עשאן שני גופין, דכתיב (שם) שתים שני עשרונים. וסדרים דלחם הפנים ילפינן משתי הלחם, אפי' למאן דלא יליף מלתא ממלתא, דהכא דמו אהדדי טפי:
Tosafot on Menachot 14b:2:1.english: The verse renders them one body - For it is written: "You shall bring wave-bread" (Leviticus 23:17) [in the singular]; and the verse renders them two bodies, as it is written: "Two [loaves] of two-tenths [of an ephah]" (ibid.). And the arrangements of the Showbread we derive from the Two Loaves, even according to the one who does not derive one matter from another, for here they resemble each other more.

Tosafot on Menachot 14b:4:1.hebrew: פיגל בלחמי תודה מהו - הוא הדין דהוה מצי למבעי ברקיקי נזיר, שיש שני מינין:
Tosafot on Menachot 14b:4:1.english: [If] one had intent of piggul with regard to the loaves of a thanks offering, what is [the law] - The same [law] applies, that [Rabbi Yochanan] could have asked regarding the wafers of a nazirite, in which there are two types.

Tosafot on Menachot 14b:6:1.hebrew: שחיטה וזריקה תרווייהו מתירין הן - פירש בקונטרס שהשחיטה מקדשת את הדם, ואמרינן בסוף פירקין דבא לקדש כבא להתיר דמי. וא"ת: קבלה נמי מקדשת את הדם בכלי שרת? לאו פירכא היא, דדם סכין מקדשא ליה, כדאמרינן בסוף פירקין:
Tosafot on Menachot 14b:6:1.english: Slaughter and sprinkling, both of them are permitting factors - The Kuntres [Rashi] explained that slaughter sanctifies the blood, and we say at the end of our chapter that that which comes to sanctify is considered like that which comes to permit. And if you say: Does not collection also sanctify the blood in a service vessel? This is no refutation, for it is the knife that sanctifies the blood, as we say at the end of our chapter.
